import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_NODES_COUNT = 10;
    static final int MODULUS_CONST = 1000000007;

    static class Modular {
        int val;

        Modular(long v) {
            v %= MODULUS_CONST;
            if (v < 0) v += MODULUS_CONST;
            this.val = (int) v;
        }

        static int extendedGCD(int a, int m, int[] xy) {
            if (m == 0) {
                xy[0] = 1; xy[1] = 0;
                return a;
            }
            int[] yx = new int[2];
            int g = extendedGCD(m, a % m, yx);
            xy[1] -= (a / m) * yx[0];
            xy[0] = yx[1];
            return g;
        }

        static int modInverse(int a) {
            int[] xy = new int[2];
            extendedGCD(a, MODULUS_CONST, xy);
            int x = xy[0];
            return (x % MODULUS_CONST + MODULUS_CONST) % MODULUS_CONST;
        }

        Modular add(Modular other) {
            int res = this.val + other.val;
            if (res >= MODULUS_CONST) res -= MODULUS_CONST;
            return new Modular(res);
        }

        Modular subtract(Modular other) {
            int res = this.val - other.val;
            if (res < 0) res += MODULUS_CONST;
            return new Modular(res);
        }

        Modular multiply(Modular other) {
            long res = (long) this.val * other.val;
            res %= MODULUS_CONST;
            return new Modular(res);
        }

        Modular divide(Modular other) {
            return this.multiply(new Modular(modInverse(other.val)));
        }

        Modular pow(long p) {
            assert p >= 0;
            Modular base = this;
            Modular result = new Modular(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) result = result.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return val;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            if (!(obj instanceof Modular)) return false;
            return this.val == ((Modular) obj).val;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int total_N_value = sc.nextInt();

        Modular[][] prob_matrix = new Modular[total_N_value][total_N_value];
        for (int i = 0; i < total_N_value; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < total_N_value; j++) {
                int p = sc.nextInt();
                prob_matrix[i][j] = new Modular(p).divide(new Modular(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masks_by_popcount = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int c = 0; c <= total_N_value; c++) {
            masks_by_popcount.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        int[] lookup_idx = new int[1 << total_N_value];
        Arrays.fill(lookup_idx, -1);
        for (int m = 0; m < (1 << total_N_value); m++) {
            int c = Integer.bitCount(m);
            lookup_idx[m] = masks_by_popcount.get(c).size();
            masks_by_popcount.get(c).add(m);
        }

        Map<Long, Modular> possible_states_map = new HashMap<>();
        long initialKey = 1L << lookup_idx[0];
        possible_states_map.put(initialKey, new Modular(1));

        for (int left_part = 0; left_part < total_N_value; left_part++) {
            Map<Long, Modular> new_states_map = new HashMap<>();
            Modular[] product_mask_vec = new Modular[1 << total_N_value];
            Arrays.fill(product_mask_vec, new Modular(1));
            for (int current_mask = 0; current_mask < (1 << total_N_value); current_mask++) {
                Modular prod = new Modular(1);
                for (int r = 0; r < total_N_value; r++) {
                    if (((current_mask >> r) & 1) == 1) {
                        prod = prod.multiply(prob_matrix[left_part][r]);
                    } else {
                        prod = prod.multiply(new Modular(1).subtract(prob_matrix[left_part][r]));
                    }
                }
                product_mask_vec[current_mask] = prod;
            }

            long[] new_bits_vec = new long[total_N_value];
            Modular[] new_possible_mask_vec = new Modular[1 << total_N_value];
            Arrays.fill(new_possible_mask_vec, new Modular(0));

            for (Map.Entry<Long, Modular> state : possible_states_map.entrySet()) {
                long current_mask_state = state.getKey();
                Modular prob_value = state.getValue();

                Arrays.fill(new_bits_vec, 0);
                for (int m : masks_by_popcount.get(left_part)) {
                    if (((current_mask_state >> lookup_idx[m]) & 1) == 1) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < total_N_value; i++) {
                            if (((m >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                                long new_mask = 1L << lookup_idx[m | (1 << i)];
                                new_bits_vec[i] |= new_mask;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Arrays.fill(new_possible_mask_vec, new Modular(0));
                for (int curr_mask = 1; curr_mask < (1 << total_N_value); curr_mask++) {
                    long prev_mask = curr_mask & (curr_mask - 1);
                    int ctz = Long.numberOfTrailingZeros(curr_mask);
                    new_possible_mask_vec[curr_mask] = new_possible_mask_vec[(int) prev_mask]
                            .add(new Modular(new_bits_vec[ctz]));
                    Modular val = prob_value.multiply(product_mask_vec[curr_mask]);
                    new_possible_mask_vec[curr_mask] = new_possible_mask_vec[curr_mask].add(val);
                }

                for (int msk = 1; msk < (1 << total_N_value); msk++) {
                    long key = new_possible_mask_vec[msk].hashCode() == 0 ? 0 : new_possible_mask_vec[msk].hashCode();
                    // To avoid hash collisions, use a proper hash, but for simplicity, use the value as key
                    long key2 = Long.hashCode(new_possible_mask_vec[msk].val);
                    long combinedKey = key2;
                    new_states_map.put(combinedKey, new_possible_mask_vec[msk]);
                }
            }
            possible_states_map = new HashMap<>(new_states_map);
        }

        Modular total_res = new Modular(0);
        long final_bit = 1L << lookup_idx[(1 << total_N_value) - 1];
        for (Map.Entry<Long, Modular> state : possible_states_map.entrySet()) {
            long key = state.getKey();
            Modular val = state.getValue();
            if (((key >> lookup_idx[(1 << total_N_value) - 1]) & 1) == 1) {
                total_res = total_res.add(val);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(total_res.val);
    }
}
